original_text:
Subject: Reactivate Your AdWords Google Account.

--------------------------------
----------------------------
-------------------------------
Dear Advertiser,

We were unable to process your payment.

Your ads will be suspended soon unless we can process your payment.

To prevent your ads from being suspended, please update your payment information.

Please sign into your account and update your payment information.

We look forward to providing you with the most effective advertising available.

Thank you for advertising with Google AdWords.


----------------------------------------------
--------------------
-------------------
rewrite_text:
Subject: AdWords Account Payment Issue

Dear Advertiser,

A recent payment could not be processed.

Your advertisements may be suspended if this issue is not resolved.

To avoid potential disruption to your campaigns, please update your payment information.

Please log in to your account to review and update your payment details.

Thank you for using Google AdWords.
